title: Materials informatics and high-throughput synthesis identify durable oxide-ion conductors
summary: A machine-learning model trained on literature conductivity data screened inorganic crystal structures and narrowed the chemical space explored by high-throughput synthesis. The study reports high conductivity and thermal durability in selected Ca-(Nb,Ta)-Bi-O compositions; oxygen concentration-cell measurements gave oxide-ion transport numbers around 70–80% at 973 K. The result came from the combined informatics and experimental workflow. It does not establish a pure ionic conductor or room-temperature electrolyte.
ai_technology: Machine-learning materials informatics; partial least-squares regression

evidence.tested: High-throughput film libraries and bulk samples were synthesized and characterized; oxygen concentration cells measured oxide-ion transport numbers around 70–80% at 973 K.
evidence.unknown: The high-temperature transport result does not establish a pure ionic conductor or room-temperature electrolyte; supplementary details were not checked in this source review.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning model trained on literature oxide-ion conductivities screened crystal structures and helped narrow element combinations for high-throughput experimental synthesis and evaluation.

source_review.scope: publisher primary full text, methods/results and publication metadata
